test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Q is second to the right of P. Only three people sit between Q and S. T is fourth to the right of S. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated in the row?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) T is fourth to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f6ebd8b676eb443e4560c6ece4773ffa4e54f47912439483672977d7a9c320f.png] 

2) Only three people sit between Q and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aee9444a92d31ca7f130d5bb81316daaf7b2a22b949ee2a3ff21e6e4815d4242.png] 

3) Q is second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04e465e06cc6cb3e587ce8c70b8dc07ba1ee28e383fce5aed86bd15ae2eb26f6.png] 

Thus, if no other person is sitting in the row, then the total number of people seated in the row is 11.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
